verdict.rationale: Unity ships a built-in AI Assistant package (com.unity.ai.assistant) in the Editor. Its docs say it can create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance and perform project actions from natural-language prompts, which directly covers delegating tasks. Assistant messages are metered through Unity Credits. Missing for 10: GA status (the AI tools are labeled beta and the package is a 2.20.0-pre.1 pre-release), detailed docs on how far the assistant acts autonomously across multi-step tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.
